claims.text: `vol audit` is the data-quality gate for everything downstream: it checks every cached parquet against its manifest contract, assesses per-layer readiness, and regenerates `data/manifest.json` while syncing `data/manifest.yaml`.

The audit deliberately distrusts its own records: the symbol universe is rebuilt each run from the parquets actually on disk merged with `SYMBOL_UNIVERSE`, and the manifest's stale symbol list is ignored.

claims.text: Data readiness is machine-checkable: the audit exits 0 only when no source has critical issues, returns 1 when any does, and 2 on outright failure, so agents and CI can gate a training run on data health without parsing the Markdown report.

`vol backfill-rk` retrofits the noise-robust estimator: it finds cached dates where the realized kernel is NaN, refetches ticks from the [[Chunk Store]] in five-day batches, recomputes `realized_kernel` from tick log-prices, and updates each symbol's parquet in place.

claims.text: None of the volatility mathematics lives here: the cli modules orchestrate ingestion, auditing, backfill, and the live signal, but every estimator, model, and statistic they invoke is implemented in `volforecast.data`, `volforecast.models`, and `volforecast.evaluation`.
